import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import SpectralClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Filter features with strong effect sizes (|mean_y1-mean_y0| > 0.2)
    effects = [abs(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)].mean() if feats.y.sum() > 0 else 
                   feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)][feats.y==0].mean() - 
                   feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)][feats.y==1].mean()) 
               for fid in feats.ids]
    
    strong_ids = [fid for fid, eff in zip(feats.ids, effects) if eff > 0.2]
    
    if not strong_ids:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build correlation matrix for strong features
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in strong_ids]]
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(X.T)
    
    # Identify clusters using spectral clustering
    clustering = SpectralClustering(n_clusters=1, affinity='precomputed', 
                                   random_state=0)
    labels = clustering.fit_predict(1 - np.abs(corr_matrix))
    
    # Get cluster members (features with high correlation to each other)
    cluster_members = [strong_ids[i] for i in range(len(strong_ids)) if labels[i] == labels[0]]
    
    # If too few or too many members, fall back to individual features
    if len(cluster_members) < 2 or len(cluster_members) > 10:
        # Select top features based on effect size
        effect_scores = [(fid, abs(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)].mean() if feats.y.sum() > 0 else 
                                   feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)][feats.y==0].mean() - 
                                   feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)][feats.y==1].mean())) 
                        for fid in strong_ids]
        cluster_members = [fid for fid, _ in sorted(effect_scores, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Compute weighted score using first principal component
    X_cluster = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in cluster_members]]
    _, _, Vt = np.linalg.svd(X_cluster, full_matrices=False)
    weights = Vt[0] / np.linalg.norm(Vt[0])
    loadings = dict(zip(cluster_members, weights))
    
    # Select top features by effect size for drivers (at most MAX_DRIVERS)
    effect_scores = [(fid, abs(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)].mean() if feats.y.sum() > 0 else 
                               feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)][feats.y==0].mean() - 
                               feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)][feats.y==1].mean())) 
                    for fid in cluster_members]
    drivers = tuple([fid for fid, _ in sorted(effect_scores, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:MAX_DRIVERS]])
    
    # Include all cluster members in regression
    columns = tuple(cluster_members)
    
    # No interaction terms for simplicity
    products = ()
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
